Introduction

Lingling is a Malaysian singer under LeanBranding. She is a member of the girl group KIIRAS and made her debut in the group on June 9, 2025, with the mini album "KILL MA BO$$".

In 2024, she was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she was sadly eliminated in episode 7. At that time, she was a trainee under WAKEONE.
